# Conscious
Mindful time-tracking CLI: log time, see where it went, reflect.
```
python app.py add coding 45
python app.py                # totals
python app.py --days 7       # last week
python app.py reflect        # weekly focus prompt
python test_app.py           # tests
```
Set CONSCIOUS_LOG to change the log file. Standard library only.
